changes: The EXPRESSION page opens from SETTINGS > EXPRESSION; TRK + trig moves it to another track, and NO goes back.
Nothing changes until you switch it on: THRU and BEND start OFF. Save a preset with them ON as your default to start that way.
The power-on file is written only while the sequencer is stopped, so a write never lands in playback.
Digi Perform and Digi Expression can now be installed together.
